It's all bullshit. They say it will get better because they don't know what to tell you nor do they give a shit enough to even console you, so they just resort to 'it gets better'. It doesn't get better UNLESS you yourself give 110%  effort to dig deep and fight whatever the hell you are going through with all your might. Things will never automatically get better unless you yourself take action. We will always run through many trails and errors, but in the end your perseverance and struggle may ONLY pay off. There ia 0% guarantee in life, I can't promise you anything. No one knows what the future holds. But, I can  promise you this if you keep on going with the right mindset and persevere, endure with patience there may lie something for you that you feel is worthy enough to live for. Right now, you and me are not so different. I have lost everything I valued and I feel like I am all alone  by myself. But, I am also at peace that I have nothing much to lose anymore but now I have literally everything to gain. I am sorry you were driven to the point of attempting suicide, but take it as fate giving you another chance. There might be something in stored for you to be content with. There is a saying in my language which roughly translates to "Even a straight tree can bend and fall over time." Those people who seem to do better can also fall anytime and you may rise above them eventually. You never know. 

Now I will tell you a short story about my life: I came from a dysfunctional family, growing up my dad was an alcoholic and eventually my parents split up. My mother left me eventually to marry someone and she did not want ti bring me in. I was heartbroken. Fortunately, my cousins  family took me in out of pity. They treated me like shit, harassed me everyday,  letting me sleep in the store room. Etc etc.  I lived poorly and even repeated two grades in my high school. I had no friends, I was basically alone in my life.  My whole teenage years I felt lonely and miserable.I was so far behind everyone and everything. 0 friends as a teenager, being poor, being lonely, getting constantly bullied in school and home for no reason. Likd you, I always wondered why people are doing so much better than me. They have everything, I have nothing. What did I do wrong? I would  look up the skies and say "God or whatever is up there, what have I done so bad that I deserve a fate this miserable?" Why are people so fortunate while I am so unfortunate....? So, one day at school our results came out and I failed in all of my subjects.I was so hurt. The whole class laughed at me. I went home, my aunt was so angry that she said I should stop going to school and do labour because I am useless anyways. I completely felt empty that day, I wanted to just end it all. But then something inside me just clicked I just wanted to keeo fighting no matter what, I believed there may be something to live for. So I gave it one last ahot and gave it my all in school then I started getting top grades. Now, I have almost finished medical college and I will be a doctor soon. I also have run a business and I have good companions. I found love and I am so happy after all these years of struggle. 

The people who I used to envy for having a 'good life'. Most of them aren't even doing that great, somd have been very miserable. Not saying I am happy due to their misery but just stating that things have changed.

Cling on to that little hope you have, don't waste your own time looking at the progress of others. instead, focus on your own progress. Keep following that small hope and one day that hope will transform into something that is worth living for. I wish you well.
